question: New Zealand vs West Indies at Auckland (T20I #1108) ended in 31.2 overs with 359 combined team runs . Calculate the runs scored from non-extras and extras as a percentage of total team runs
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(runs_scored) AS non_extras, (SUM(extra_runs) * 100.0 / SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs)) AS extras_percentage FROM Deliveries WHERE match_id = 1108;
generated_sql:
WITH match_info AS (
    SELECT match_id
    FROM Matches
    WHERE city = 'Auckland'
      AND ((team1 = 'New Zealand' AND team2 = 'West Indies') 
           OR (team1 = 'West Indies' AND team2 = 'New Zealand'))
),
run_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs_scored,
        SUM(d.extra_runs) AS total_extras
    FROM Deliveries d
    INNER JOIN match_info m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
)
SELECT 
    total_runs_scored AS "Non-Extras",
    (total_extras * 100.0) / (total_runs_scored + total_extras) AS "Extras percentage"
FROM run_totals;

question: ऑकलैंड में न्यूज़ीलैंड बनाम वेस्ट इंडीज (टी20I #1108) 31.2 ओवर में समाप्त हुआ और दोनों टीमों ने मिलाकर 359 रन बनाए। नॉन-एक्स्ट्रा और एक्स्ट्रा से बने रनों को कुल टीम रनों के प्रतिशत के रूप में गणना कीजिए।
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(runs_scored) AS non_extras, (SUM(extra_runs) * 100.0 / SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs)) AS extras_percentage FROM Deliveries WHERE match_id = 1108;
generated_sql:
WITH match_total AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(runs_scored) AS total_batting_runs,
        SUM(extra_runs) AS total_extras
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE match_id = (
        SELECT m.match_id 
        FROM Matches m
        WHERE m.venue LIKE '%Auckland%'
          AND ((m.team1 = 'New Zealand' AND m.team2 = 'West Indies') 
               OR (m.team1 = 'West Indies' AND m.team2 = 'New Zealand'))
          AND m.season LIKE '%T20I%'
        LIMIT 1
    )
)
SELECT 
    (total_batting_runs + total_extras - total_extras) AS `Non-Extras`,
    ROUND((total_extras * 100.0 / (total_batting_runs + total_extras)), 2) AS `Extras percentage`
FROM match_total;

question: పూర్తయిన ఒక T20I ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లో చివరి వరకు బ్యాటింగ్ చేసిన ప్రతి ఆటగాడి పరుగులను, జట్టు మొత్తం పరుగులలో శాతంగా లెక్కించండి
gold_sql: WITH FirstDel AS (SELECT match_id, inning, MIN(delivery_id) AS min_del FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries d JOIN FirstDel fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.min_del UNION SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries d JOIN FirstDel fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.min_del), MatchStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team), BatterStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, bs.runs, ms.team_total, (bs.runs * 100.0 / ms.team_total) AS percentage_of_team_total, ms.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM BatterStats bs JOIN Openers o ON bs.match_id = o.match_id AND bs.inning = o.inning AND bs.striker_id = o.player_id JOIN MatchStats ms ON bs.match_id = ms.match_id AND bs.inning = ms.inning JOIN Matches m ON bs.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON bs.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ms.wickets = 10 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Deliveries out_d WHERE out_d.match_id = bs.match_id AND out_d.inning = bs.inning AND out_d.player_out_id = bs.striker_id) ORDER BY percentage_of_team_total DESC;
generated_sql:
WITH BattingTeam AS (
    SELECT d.batting_team, d.match_id, d.inning
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.match_id = 1 AND d.inning = 1
    GROUP BY d.batting_team
),
TeamTotalRuns AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
        d.batting_team,
        d.match_id,
        d.inning
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.match_id = 1 AND d.inning = 1
    GROUP BY d.batting_team
),
PlayerRuns AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name AS Player,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Runs,
        bt.batting_team AS Team,
        d.match_id,
        d.inning
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    JOIN BattingTeam bt ON d.match_id = bt.match_id AND d.inning = bt.inning
    WHERE d.match_id = 1 AND d.inning = 1
    GROUP BY d.striker_id
),
NotOutPlayers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        CASE 
            WHEN d.player_out_id IS NULL THEN d.striker_id
            WHEN d.player_out_id IS NULL THEN d.non_striker_id
        END AS player_id
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.match_id = 1 AND d.inning = 1
    EXCEPT
    SELECT d.player_out_id
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.match_id = 1 AND d.inning = 1 AND d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    pr.Player,
    pr.Runs,
    ttr.total_runs AS "Team Total",
    ROUND((pr.Runs * 100.0) / ttr.total_runs, 2) AS "Runs as % of Team Total"
FROM PlayerRuns pr
JOIN TeamTotalRuns ttr ON pr.Team = ttr.batting_team AND pr.match_id = ttr.match_id AND pr.inning = ttr.inning
JOIN NotOutPlayers nop ON pr.Player = nop.player_id
ORDER BY pr.Runs DESC;

question: ਹਰੇਕ ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਜਿਸਨੇ ਪੂਰੀ T20I ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਾਟ ਆਊਟ ਰਿਹਾ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਕੁੱਲ ਟੀਮ ਸਕੋਰ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਵਜੋਂ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ?
gold_sql: WITH FirstDel AS (SELECT match_id, inning, MIN(delivery_id) AS min_del FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries d JOIN FirstDel fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.min_del UNION SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries d JOIN FirstDel fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.min_del), MatchStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team), BatterStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, bs.runs, ms.team_total, (bs.runs * 100.0 / ms.team_total) AS percentage_of_team_total, ms.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM BatterStats bs JOIN Openers o ON bs.match_id = o.match_id AND bs.inning = o.inning AND bs.striker_id = o.player_id JOIN MatchStats ms ON bs.match_id = ms.match_id AND bs.inning = ms.inning JOIN Matches m ON bs.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON bs.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ms.wickets = 10 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Deliveries out_d WHERE out_d.match_id = bs.match_id AND out_d.inning = bs.inning AND out_d.player_out_id = bs.striker_id) ORDER BY percentage_of_team_total DESC;
generated_sql:
WITH TeamTotals AS (
    SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total
    FROM Deliveries
    GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team
),
BatterInnings AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT match_id, inning, striker_id AS player_id, batting_team
    FROM Deliveries
),
OutPlayers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT match_id, inning, player_out_id AS player_id
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL
),
NotOutBatters AS (
    SELECT bi.match_id, bi.inning, bi.player_id, bi.batting_team
    FROM BatterInnings bi
    LEFT JOIN OutPlayers op ON bi.match_id = op.match_id AND bi.inning = op.inning AND bi.player_id = op.player_id
    WHERE op.player_id IS NULL
),
PlayerRuns AS (
    SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id AS player_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS player_runs
    FROM Deliveries
    GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player,
    pr.player_runs AS Runs,
    tt.team_total AS "Team Total",
    (pr.player_runs * 100.0 / tt.team_total) AS "Runs as % of Team Total"
FROM NotOutBatters nob
JOIN PlayerRuns pr ON nob.match_id = pr.match_id AND nob.inning = pr.inning AND nob.player_id = pr.player_id
JOIN TeamTotals tt ON nob.match_id = tt.match_id AND nob.inning = tt.inning AND nob.batting_team = tt.batting_team
JOIN Players p ON nob.player_id = p.player_id;

question: For each player who carried the bat through a completed T20I innings, calculate their runs as a percentage of the team total.
gold_sql: WITH FirstDel AS (SELECT match_id, inning, MIN(delivery_id) AS min_del FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries d JOIN FirstDel fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.min_del UNION SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries d JOIN FirstDel fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.min_del), MatchStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team), BatterStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, bs.runs, ms.team_total, (bs.runs * 100.0 / ms.team_total) AS percentage_of_team_total, ms.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM BatterStats bs JOIN Openers o ON bs.match_id = o.match_id AND bs.inning = o.inning AND bs.striker_id = o.player_id JOIN MatchStats ms ON bs.match_id = ms.match_id AND bs.inning = ms.inning JOIN Matches m ON bs.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON bs.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ms.wickets = 10 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Deliveries out_d WHERE out_d.match_id = bs.match_id AND out_d.inning = bs.inning AND out_d.player_out_id = bs.striker_id) ORDER BY percentage_of_team_total DESC;
generated_sql:
WITH completed_innings AS (
  SELECT 
    d.match_id,
    d.inning,
    d.batting_team,
    CASE 
      WHEN MAX(d.over_number) = 20 AND MAX(d.ball_number) = 6 THEN 1
      WHEN (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d2.player_out_id) 
        FROM Deliveries d2 
        WHERE d2.match_id = d.match_id 
          AND d2.inning = d.inning 
          AND d2.player_out_id IS NOT NULL
      ) = 10 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS innings_completed
  FROM Deliveries d
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team
  HAVING innings_completed = 1
),
opening_batters AS (
  SELECT 
    d.match_id,
    d.inning,
    d.striker_id AS player_id,
    p.player_name,
    d.batting_team,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.over_number, d.ball_number, d.delivery_id) AS delivery_order
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
  WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    d.match_id,
    d.inning,
    d.non_striker_id AS player_id,
    p.player_name,
    d.batting_team,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY d.over_number, d.ball_number, d.delivery_id) AS delivery_order
  FROM Deliveries d
  JOIN Players p ON d.non_striker_id = p.player_id
  WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
),
first_two_batters AS (
  SELECT 
    match_id,
    inning,
    player_id,
    player_name,
    batting_team
  FROM opening_batters
  WHERE delivery_order <= 2
  GROUP BY match_id, inning, player_id, player_name, batting_team
),
not_out_batters AS (
  SELECT 
    d.match_id,
    d.inning,
    d.striker_id AS player_id
  FROM Deliveries d
  WHERE d.player_out_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id
  EXCEPT
  SELECT 
    match_id,
    inning,
    player_out_id AS player_id
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL
),
carried_bat AS (
  SELECT 
    ftb.match_id,
    ftb.inning,
    ftb.player_id,
    ftb.player_name AS Player,
    ftb.batting_team
  FROM first_two_batters ftb
  JOIN completed_innings ci ON ftb.match_id = ci.match_id AND ftb.inning = ci.inning
  JOIN not_out_batters nob ON ftb.match_id = nob.match_id 
    AND ftb.inning = nob.inning 
    AND ftb.player_id = nob.player_id
),
player_runs AS (
  SELECT 
    d.match_id,
    d.inning,
    d.striker_id AS player_id,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS Runs
  FROM Deliveries d
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id
),
team_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    d.match_id,
    d.inning,
    d.batting_team,
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS "Team Total"
  FROM Deliveries d
  GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team
)
SELECT 
  cb.Player,
  pr.Runs,
  tt."Team Total",
  ROUND((pr.Runs * 100.0 / tt."Team Total"), 2) AS "Runs as % of Team Total"
FROM carried_bat cb
JOIN player_runs pr ON cb.match_id = pr.match_id 
  AND cb.inning = pr.inning 
  AND cb.player_id = pr.player_id
JOIN team_totals tt ON cb.match_id = tt.match_id 
  AND cb.inning = tt.inning 
  AND cb.batting_team = tt.batting_team
ORDER BY cb.Player, cb.match_id, cb.inning;

question: ఆక్లాండ్‌లో జరిగిన న్యూజిలాండ్ vs వెస్ట్ ఇండీస్ (T20I #1108) మ్యాచ్ 31.2 ఓవర్లలో ముగిసింది, ఇందులో ఇరు జట్లు కలిసి 359 పరుగులు చేశాయి. మొత్తం జట్టు పరుగులలో నాన్-ఎక్స్‌ట్రాలు మరియు ఎక్స్‌ట్రాల ద్వారా వచ్చిన పరుగుల శాతాన్ని లెక్కించండి
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(runs_scored) AS non_extras, (SUM(extra_runs) * 100.0 / SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs)) AS extras_percentage FROM Deliveries WHERE match_id = 1108;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(runs_scored) AS [Non-Extras],
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(extra_runs) / (SUM(runs_scored) + SUM(extra_runs)), 2) AS [Extras percentage]
FROM Deliveries d
WHERE match_id = (
    SELECT match_id 
    FROM Matches

question: Auckland ਵਿੱਚ New Zealand ਬਨਾਮ West Indies ਮੈਚ 31.2 ਓਵਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ 359 ਕੁੱਲ ਟੀਮ ਰਨਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਸਮਾਪਤ ਹੋਇਆ। ਗੈਰ-ਵਾਧੂ ਰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਕੁੱਲ ਟੀਮ ਰਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਵਜੋਂ ਵਾਧੂ ਰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਵੀ ਗਣਨਾ ਕਰੋ?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(runs_scored) AS non_extras, (SUM(extra_runs) * 100.0 / SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs)) AS extras_percentage FROM Deliveries WHERE match_id = 1108;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(D.runs_scored) AS "Non-Extras",
    (SUM(D.extra_runs) * 100.0) / SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS "Extras percentage"
FROM Matches M
JOIN Deliveries D ON M.match_id = D.match_id
WHERE M.city = 'Auckland'
    AND (
        (M.team1 = 'New Zealand' AND M.team2 = 'West Indies')
        OR (M.team1 = 'West Indies' AND M.team2 = 'New Zealand')
    )
GROUP BY M.match_id, D.inning, D.batting_team
HAVING SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) = 359
    AND COUNT(CASE WHEN D.wides = 0 AND D.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) = 188;

question: टी20 विश्व कप इतिहास में, 16 या उससे अधिक कैच वाले खिलाड़ियों में किस दक्षिण अफ्रीकी फील्डर का Ct/Inn अनुपात सबसे अधिक है, साथ ही कुल कैच और एक पारी में सर्वाधिक कैच भी बताइए?
gold_sql: WITH FieldingInnings AS (SELECT pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS catches_in_innings FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.team_name = d.bowling_team LEFT JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.delivery_id AND fd.fielder_id = pim.player_id WHERE pim.team_name = 'South Africa' GROUP BY pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning), FielderStats AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(catches_in_innings) AS total_catches, COUNT(match_id) AS innings_fielded, MAX(catches_in_innings) AS max_catches_in_inning FROM FieldingInnings GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name AS fielder, fs.total_catches, fs.innings_fielded, ROUND(CAST(fs.total_catches AS FLOAT) / fs.innings_fielded, 3) AS ct_inn_ratio, fs.max_catches_in_inning FROM FielderStats fs JOIN Players p ON fs.player_id = p.player_id WHERE fs.total_catches >= 16 ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH SouthAfricanPlayers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_id
    FROM PlayerInMatch
    WHERE team_name = 'South Africa'
),
CatchesPerInning AS (
    SELECT 
        fd.fielder_id,
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        COUNT(*) AS catches_in_inn
    FROM FielderDismissals fd
    JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE d.wicket_type LIKE '%caught%'
      AND fd.fielder_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM SouthAfricanPlayers)
    GROUP BY fd.fielder_id, d.match_id, d.inning
),
PlayerStats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_id,
        p.player_name,
        SUM(cpi.catches_in_inn) AS total_catches,
        MAX(cpi.catches_in_inn) AS max_catches_in_innings,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id || '-' || d.inning) AS innings_fielded
    FROM Players p
    JOIN CatchesPerInning cpi ON p.player_id = cpi.fielder_id
    JOIN Deliveries d ON cpi.match_id = d.match_id AND cpi.inning = d.inning
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
    HAVING total_catches >= 16
)
SELECT 
    player_name AS "Player Name",
    total_catches AS "Total Catches",
    max_catches_in_innings AS "Max Catches in Innings",
    ROUND(CAST(total_catches AS REAL) / innings_fielded, 2) AS "CT/Inn ratio"
FROM PlayerStats
ORDER BY "CT/Inn ratio" DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: In T20 World Cup history, which South African fielder has the highest Ct/Inn ratio among all players with 16+ catches,  total catches, and Maximum catches in a single innings?
gold_sql: WITH FieldingInnings AS (SELECT pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS catches_in_innings FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.team_name = d.bowling_team LEFT JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.delivery_id AND fd.fielder_id = pim.player_id WHERE pim.team_name = 'South Africa' GROUP BY pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning), FielderStats AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(catches_in_innings) AS total_catches, COUNT(match_id) AS innings_fielded, MAX(catches_in_innings) AS max_catches_in_inning FROM FieldingInnings GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name AS fielder, fs.total_catches, fs.innings_fielded, ROUND(CAST(fs.total_catches AS FLOAT) / fs.innings_fielded, 3) AS ct_inn_ratio, fs.max_catches_in_inning FROM FielderStats fs JOIN Players p ON fs.player_id = p.player_id WHERE fs.total_catches >= 16 ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH T20Matches AS (
    SELECT match_id 
    FROM Matches 
    WHERE season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
),
FieldingInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        fd.fielder_id,
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        COUNT(*) AS catches_in_innings
    FROM FielderDismissals fd
    JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
    JOIN T20Matches tm ON d.match_id = tm.match_id
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON fd.fielder_id = pim.player_id AND d.match_id = pim.match_id
    WHERE pim.team_name = 'South Africa'
    GROUP BY fd.fielder_id, d.match_id, d.inning
),
FieldingStats AS (
    SELECT 
        fielder_id,
        SUM(catches_in_innings) AS total_catches,
        MAX(catches_in_innings) AS max_catches_in_innings,
        COUNT(DISTINCT match_id || '|' || inning) AS innings_fielded
    FROM FieldingInnings
    GROUP BY fielder_id
    HAVING total_catches >= 16
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS "Player Name",
    fs.total_catches AS "Total Catches",
    fs.max_catches_in_innings AS "Max Catches in Innings",
    ROUND(1.0 * fs.total_catches / fs.innings_fielded, 2) AS "CT/Inn ratio"
FROM FieldingStats fs
JOIN Players p ON fs.fielder_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY "CT/Inn ratio" DESC;

question: जिन खिलाड़ियों ने पूर्ण टी20I पारी में कैरी द बैट किया, उनमें प्रत्येक खिलाड़ी के रन टीम के कुल स्कोर का कितने प्रतिशत थे, इसकी गणना कीजिए।
gold_sql: WITH FirstDel AS (SELECT match_id, inning, MIN(delivery_id) AS min_del FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning), Openers AS (SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries d JOIN FirstDel fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.min_del UNION SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.non_striker_id AS player_id FROM Deliveries d JOIN FirstDel fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.min_del), MatchStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS team_total, SUM(CASE WHEN player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired not out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team), BatterStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id) SELECT p.player_name, bs.runs, ms.team_total, (bs.runs * 100.0 / ms.team_total) AS percentage_of_team_total, ms.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM BatterStats bs JOIN Openers o ON bs.match_id = o.match_id AND bs.inning = o.inning AND bs.striker_id = o.player_id JOIN MatchStats ms ON bs.match_id = ms.match_id AND bs.inning = ms.inning JOIN Matches m ON bs.match_id = m.match_id JOIN Players p ON bs.striker_id = p.player_id WHERE ms.wickets = 10 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Deliveries out_d WHERE out_d.match_id = bs.match_id AND out_d.inning = bs.inning AND out_d.player_out_id = bs.striker_id) ORDER BY percentage_of_team_total DESC;
generated_sql:
WITH OrderedDeliveries AS (
    SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, 
           d.striker_id, d.non_striker_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team ORDER BY d.over_number, d.ball_number) AS rn
    FROM Deliveries d
),
FirstDelivery AS (
    SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, striker_id, non_striker_id
    FROM OrderedDeliveries
    WHERE rn = 1
),
Openers AS (
    SELECT fd.match_id, fd.inning, fd.batting_team, fd.striker_id AS player_id
    FROM FirstDelivery fd
    UNION ALL
    SELECT fd.match_id, fd.inning, fd.batting_team, fd.non_striker_id AS player_id
    FROM FirstDelivery fd
),
DismissedPlayers AS (
    SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.player_out_id AS player_id
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.player_out_id
),
CarriedBatPlayers AS (
    SELECT o.match_id, o.inning, o.batting_team, o.player_id
    FROM Openers o
    LEFT JOIN DismissedPlayers dp ON o.match_id = dp.match_id AND o.inning = dp.inning AND o.player_id = dp.player_id
    WHERE dp.player_id IS NULL
),
TeamTotals AS (
    SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team,
           SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS team_total
    FROM Deliveries d
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team
),
PlayerRuns AS (
    SELECT d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id AS player_id,
           SUM(d.runs_scored) AS player_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS Player,
    pr.player_runs AS Runs,
    tt.team_total AS "Team Total",
    (pr.player_runs * 100.0 / tt.team_total) AS "Runs as % of Team Total"
FROM CarriedBatPlayers cbp
JOIN Players p ON cbp.player_id = p.player_id
JOIN PlayerRuns pr ON cbp.match_id = pr.match_id AND cbp.inning = pr.inning AND cbp.player_id = pr.player_id
JOIN TeamTotals tt ON cbp.match_id = tt.match_id AND cbp.inning = tt.inning AND cbp.batting_team = tt.batting_team
ORDER BY Player, Runs DESC;

question: T20 ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ, 16 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਕੈਚਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਸ ਦੱਖਣੀ ਅਫ਼ਰੀਕੀ ਫ਼ੀਲਡਰ ਦੀ Ct/Inn ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਹੈ, ਕੁੱਲ ਕੈਚ ਅਤੇ ਇੱਕੋ ਪਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਧ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਕੈਚ ਵੀ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH FieldingInnings AS (SELECT pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS catches_in_innings FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.team_name = d.bowling_team LEFT JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.delivery_id AND fd.fielder_id = pim.player_id WHERE pim.team_name = 'South Africa' GROUP BY pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning), FielderStats AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(catches_in_innings) AS total_catches, COUNT(match_id) AS innings_fielded, MAX(catches_in_innings) AS max_catches_in_inning FROM FieldingInnings GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name AS fielder, fs.total_catches, fs.innings_fielded, ROUND(CAST(fs.total_catches AS FLOAT) / fs.innings_fielded, 3) AS ct_inn_ratio, fs.max_catches_in_inning FROM FielderStats fs JOIN Players p ON fs.player_id = p.player_id WHERE fs.total_catches >= 16 ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH SouthAfricanPlayers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_id
    FROM PlayerInMatch
    WHERE team_name = 'South Africa'
),
CatchesPerPlayer AS (
    SELECT 
        fd.fielder_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_catches
    FROM FielderDismissals fd
    INNER JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
    WHERE fd.fielder_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM SouthAfricanPlayers)
    GROUP BY fd.fielder_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 16
),
CatchesPerInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        fd.fielder_id,
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        COUNT(*) AS catches_in_innings
    FROM FielderDismissals fd
    INNER JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
    WHERE fd.fielder_id IN (SELECT player_id FROM SouthAfricanPlayers)
    GROUP BY fd.fielder_id, d.match_id, d.inning
),
MatchesPlayed AS (
    SELECT 
        pim.player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pim.match_id) AS matches_played
    FROM PlayerInMatch pim
    WHERE pim.team_name = 'South Africa'
    GROUP BY pim.player_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS "Player Name",
    cp.total_catches AS "Total Catches",
    MAX(cpi.catches_in_innings) AS "Max Catches in Innings",
    ROUND(1.0 * cp.total_catches / (2 * mp.matches_played), 2) AS "CT/Inn ratio"
FROM Players p
INNER JOIN CatchesPerPlayer cp ON p.player_id = cp.fielder_id
INNER JOIN MatchesPlayed mp ON p.player_id = mp.player_id
INNER JOIN CatchesPerInnings cpi ON p.player_id = cpi.fielder_id
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, cp.total_catches, mp.matches_played
ORDER BY "CT/Inn ratio" DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20 వరల్డ్ కప్పు ఇతిహాసలో కనీసం 16 క్యాచులు పట్టిన సౌత్ ఆఫ్రికా ఫీల్డర్లలో ఒక మ్యాచ్కు ఎక్కువ క్యాచులు పట్టే (Ct/Inn ఎక్కువగా ఉన్న) క్రీడాకారుడు ఎవరు? అతని మొత్తం క్యాచులు మరియు ఒక ఇన్నింగ్స్లో అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ క్యాచులు రాయండి.
gold_sql: WITH FieldingInnings AS (SELECT pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, COUNT(fd.fielder_dismissal_id) AS catches_in_innings FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.team_name = d.bowling_team LEFT JOIN FielderDismissals fd ON d.delivery_id = fd.delivery_id AND fd.fielder_id = pim.player_id WHERE pim.team_name = 'South Africa' GROUP BY pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning), FielderStats AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(catches_in_innings) AS total_catches, COUNT(match_id) AS innings_fielded, MAX(catches_in_innings) AS max_catches_in_inning FROM FieldingInnings GROUP BY player_id) SELECT p.player_name AS fielder, fs.total_catches, fs.innings_fielded, ROUND(CAST(fs.total_catches AS FLOAT) / fs.innings_fielded, 3) AS ct_inn_ratio, fs.max_catches_in_inning FROM FielderStats fs JOIN Players p ON fs.player_id = p.player_id WHERE fs.total_catches >= 16 ORDER BY ct_inn_ratio DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH SouthAfricanCatches AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_id,
        p.player_name,
        d.inning,
        d.match_id,
        COUNT(*) AS catches_in_innings
    FROM FielderDismissals fd
    JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
    JOIN Players p ON fd.fielder_id = p.player_id
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON fd.fielder_id = pim.player_id AND d.match_id = pim.match_id
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE pim.team_name = 'South Africa' 
      AND m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
      AND d.wicket_type = 'caught'
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, d.match_id, d.inning
),
TotalCatches AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        player_name,
        SUM(catches_in_innings) AS total_catches,
        MAX(catches_in_innings) AS max_catches_in_innings,
        COUNT(*) AS innings_count
    FROM SouthAfricanCatches
    GROUP BY player_id, player_name
    HAVING total_catches >= 16
)
SELECT 
    player_name AS 'Player Name',
    total_catches AS 'Total Catches',
    max_catches_in_innings AS 'Max Catches in Innings',
    ROUND(total_catches * 1.0 / innings_count, 2) AS 'CT/Inn ratio'
FROM TotalCatches
ORDER BY 4 DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which instances in the most runs off one over records in T20Is involved a wicket being taken in the same over? List the player, runs, bowler, match, venue, and date.
gold_sql: WITH WicketOvers AS (SELECT DISTINCT match_id, inning, over_number FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p_striker.player_name AS player, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, p_bowler.player_name AS bowler, m.team1 || ' vs ' || m.team2 AS match, m.venue, m.match_date AS date FROM Deliveries d JOIN WicketOvers wo ON d.match_id = wo.match_id AND d.inning = wo.inning AND d.over_number = wo.over_number JOIN Players p_striker ON d.striker_id = p_striker.player_id JOIN Players p_bowler ON d.bowler_id = p_bowler.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, d.striker_id, d.bowler_id, p_striker.player_name, p_bowler.player_name, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.match_date ORDER BY runs DESC;

        COUNT(CASE WHEN wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS wickets_in_over
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE wides = 0 AND noballs = 0
    GROUP BY match_id, inning, over_number, striker_id, bowler_id
    HAVING wickets_in_over > 0
)
SELECT 
    p1.player_name AS "Player Name",
    oruns.total_runs AS "Runs",

    m.team1 || ' vs ' || m.team2 AS "Match",
    m.venue AS "Venue",
    m.match_date AS "Date"
FROM OverRuns oruns
JOIN Matches m ON oruns.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p1 ON oruns.striker_id = p1.player_id
JOIN Players p2 ON oruns.bowler_id = p2.player_id
ORDER BY oruns.total_runs DESC, m.match_date DESC;

question: टी20I में एक ओवर में सबसे ज़्यादा रन के रिकॉर्ड वाले किन उदाहरणों में उसी ओवर में विकेट भी गिरा? खिलाड़ी, रन, गेंदबाज़, मैच, स्थल और तारीख बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH WicketOvers AS (SELECT DISTINCT match_id, inning, over_number FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p_striker.player_name AS player, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, p_bowler.player_name AS bowler, m.team1 || ' vs ' || m.team2 AS match, m.venue, m.match_date AS date FROM Deliveries d JOIN WicketOvers wo ON d.match_id = wo.match_id AND d.inning = wo.inning AND d.over_number = wo.over_number JOIN Players p_striker ON d.striker_id = p_striker.player_id JOIN Players p_bowler ON d.bowler_id = p_bowler.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, d.striker_id, d.bowler_id, p_striker.player_name, p_bowler.player_name, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.match_date ORDER BY runs DESC;
gold_answer: ["('Rakep Patel', 31, 'Bright Balala', 'Kenya v Malawi', 'Nairobi', '04/07/2024')", "('Mohammad Nabi', 32, 'Dunith Wellalage', 'Afghanistan v Sri Lanka', 'Abu Dhabi', '18/09/2025')"]
generated_sql:
WITH OverStats AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.over_number,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) as over_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wicket_count,
        MIN(d.bowler_id) as bowler_id
    FROM Deliveries d
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number
),
MaxRuns AS (
    SELECT MAX(over_runs) as max_over_runs
    FROM OverStats
)
SELECT 
    p_out.player_name AS "Player Name",
    os.over_runs AS "Runs",
    p_bow.player_name AS "Bowler",
    m.team1 || ' vs ' || m.team2 AS "Match",
    m.venue AS "Venue",
    m.match_date AS "Date"
FROM OverStats os
JOIN MaxRuns mr ON os.over_runs = mr.max_over_runs
JOIN Matches m ON os.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p_bow ON os.bowler_id = p_bow.player_id
JOIN Deliveries d_out ON os.match_id = d_out.match_id AND os.inning = d_out.inning AND os.over_number = d_out.over_number AND d_out.wicket_type IS NOT NULL
JOIN Players p_out ON d_out.player_out_id = p_out.player_id
WHERE os.wicket_count > 0
ORDER BY os.match_id, os.inning, os.over_number, d_out.ball_number;

question: T20Iలలో ఒకే ఓవర్‌లో అత్యధిక పరుగులు చేసిన రికార్డులలో, అదే ఓవర్‌లో వికెట్ కూడా పడిన సందర్భాలు ఏవి? ఆటగాడు, పరుగులు, బౌలర్, మ్యాచ్, వేదిక మరియు తేదీని తెలపండి.
gold_sql: WITH WicketOvers AS (SELECT DISTINCT match_id, inning, over_number FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p_striker.player_name AS player, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, p_bowler.player_name AS bowler, m.team1 || ' vs ' || m.team2 AS match, m.venue, m.match_date AS date FROM Deliveries d JOIN WicketOvers wo ON d.match_id = wo.match_id AND d.inning = wo.inning AND d.over_number = wo.over_number JOIN Players p_striker ON d.striker_id = p_striker.player_id JOIN Players p_bowler ON d.bowler_id = p_bowler.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, d.striker_id, d.bowler_id, p_striker.player_name, p_bowler.player_name, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.match_date ORDER BY runs DESC;
gold_answer: ["('Rakep Patel', 31, 'Bright Balala', 'Kenya v Malawi', 'Nairobi', '04/07/2024')", "('Mohammad Nabi', 32, 'Dunith Wellalage', 'Afghanistan v Sri Lanka', 'Abu Dhabi', '18/09/2025')"]
generated_sql:
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.over_number,
        d.striker_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored,
        d.bowler_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wicket_in_over
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, d.striker_id
),
ranked_overs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        inning,
        over_number,
        striker_id,
        runs_scored,
        bowler_id,
        wicket_in_over,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY runs_scored DESC) AS rank
    FROM over_runs
    WHERE wicket_in_over = 1
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS "Player Name",
    ro.runs_scored AS "Runs",
    pb.player_name AS "Bowler",
    m.team1 || ' vs ' || m.team2 AS "Match",
    m.venue AS "Venue",
    m.match_date AS "Date"
FROM ranked_overs ro
JOIN Matches m ON ro.match_id = m.match_id

question: How many players scored exactly 110 runs on the losing side, and how many of them batted in 2 innings?
gold_sql: WITH LosingSideInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), PlayerTotals AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(*) AS innings_count FROM LosingSideInnings GROUP BY player_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS players_with_110_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN innings_count = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS players_with_110_in_2_innings FROM PlayerTotals WHERE total_runs = 110;
gold_column_names: Number of players with 110 runs in 2 innings
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerMatchStats AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.striker_id as player_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) as total_runs,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.inning) as innings_batted
    FROM Deliveries d
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id
),
Losing110 AS (
    SELECT 
        PMS.player_id,
        PMS.innings_batted
    FROM PlayerMatchStats PMS
    JOIN PlayerInMatch PIM ON PMS.match_id = PIM.match_id AND PMS.player_id = PIM.player_id
    JOIN Matches M ON PMS.match_id = M.match_id
    WHERE PMS.total_runs = 110 
      AND M.match_winner IS NOT NULL 
      AND M.match_winner != PIM.team_name
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) as "Number of players with 110 runs",
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN innings_batted >= 2 THEN player_id ELSE NULL END) as "Number of players with 110 runs in 2 innings"
FROM Losing110;
generated_column_names: Number of players with 110 runs in 2 innings

question: T20I ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕੋ ਓਵਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਰਿਕਾਰਡਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਮੌਕਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਸੇ ਓਵਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਕਟ ਵੀ ਲਈ ਗਈ? ਖਿਡਾਰੀ, ਰਨ, ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼, ਮੈਚ, ਮੈਦਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH WicketOvers AS (SELECT DISTINCT match_id, inning, over_number FROM Deliveries WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT p_striker.player_name AS player, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, p_bowler.player_name AS bowler, m.team1 || ' vs ' || m.team2 AS match, m.venue, m.match_date AS date FROM Deliveries d JOIN WicketOvers wo ON d.match_id = wo.match_id AND d.inning = wo.inning AND d.over_number = wo.over_number JOIN Players p_striker ON d.striker_id = p_striker.player_id JOIN Players p_bowler ON d.bowler_id = p_bowler.player_id JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.over_number, d.striker_id, d.bowler_id, p_striker.player_name, p_bowler.player_name, m.team1, m.team2, m.venue, m.match_date ORDER BY runs DESC;
gold_answer: ["('Rakep Patel', 31, 'Bright Balala', 'Kenya v Malawi', 'Nairobi', '04/07/2024')", "('Mohammad Nabi', 32, 'Dunith Wellalage', 'Afghanistan v Sri Lanka', 'Abu Dhabi', '18/09/2025')"]
generated_sql:
WITH OversWithWickets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT match_id, inning, over_number
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE wicket_type IS NOT NULL
),
RunsPerBatsmanPerOver AS (
    SELECT match_id, inning, over_number, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_in_over
    FROM Deliveries
    GROUP BY match_id, inning, over_number, striker_id
),
MaxRuns AS (
    SELECT MAX(runs_in_over) AS max_runs
    FROM RunsPerBatsmanPerOver
),
HighRunsOvers AS (
    SELECT R.match_id, R.inning, R.over_number, R.striker_id, R.runs_in_over
    FROM RunsPerBatsmanPerOver R
    JOIN MaxRuns M ON R.runs_in_over = M.max_runs
    WHERE (R.match_id, R.inning, R.over_number) IN (SELECT match_id, inning, over_number FROM OversWithWickets)
),
OverBowler AS (
    SELECT match_id, inning, over_number, MIN(bowler_id) AS bowler_id
    FROM Deliveries
    GROUP BY match_id, inning, over_number
)
SELECT 
    P1.player_name AS "Player Name",
    H.runs_in_over AS "Runs",
    P2.player_name AS "Bowler",
    M.team1 || ' vs ' || M.team2 AS "Match",
    M.venue AS "Venue",
    M.match_date AS "Date"
FROM HighRunsOvers H
JOIN Matches M ON H.match_id = M.match_id
JOIN Players P1 ON H.striker_id = P1.player_id
JOIN OverBowler OB ON H.match_id = OB.match_id AND H.inning = OB.inning AND H.over_number = OB.over_number
JOIN Players P2 ON OB.bowler_id = P2.player_id
ORDER BY H.runs_in_over DESC;

question: हारने वाली टीम की ओर से ठीक 110 रन कितने खिलाड़ियों ने बनाए, और उनमें से कितनों ने दूसरी पारी में बल्लेबाज़ी की?
gold_sql: WITH LosingSideInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), PlayerTotals AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(*) AS innings_count FROM LosingSideInnings GROUP BY player_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS players_with_110_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN innings_count = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS players_with_110_in_2_innings FROM PlayerTotals WHERE total_runs = 110;
gold_column_names: Number of players with 110 runs in 2 innings
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerRunsPerMatch AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.striker_id AS player_id,
        d.batting_team,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        MIN(d.inning) AS inning
    FROM Deliveries d
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.batting_team
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS "Number of players with 110 runs",
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN inning = 2 THEN player_id END) AS "Number of players with 110 runs in 2 innings"
FROM PlayerRunsPerMatch pr
JOIN Matches m ON pr.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE pr.total_runs = 110
  AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
  AND pr.batting_team != m.match_winner;
generated_column_names: Number of players with 110 runs in 2 innings

question: पुरुष T20Is में सबसे अधिक मैच कुल कौन से हैं?
generated_sql:
WITH MatchRuns AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.team1 AS Team1,
        m.team2 AS Team2,
        m.season AS Season,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE m.stage = 'Group'
    GROUP BY m.match_id, m.team1, m.team2, m.season
),
TeamMatchCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        team_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS total_matches
    FROM PlayerInMatch
    GROUP BY team_name
),
TopTeam AS (
    SELECT team_name 
    FROM TeamMatchCounts 
    ORDER BY total_matches DESC 
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    Team1,
    Team2,
    Season,
    total_runs AS [Total Runs]
FROM MatchRuns
WHERE Team1 = (SELECT team_name FROM TopTeam) 
   OR Team2 = (SELECT team_name FROM TopTeam)
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: ਮਰਦਾ ਦੇ T20Is ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਮੈਚ ਕੁੱਲ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਹਨ?
generated_sql:
WITH MatchTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.team1,
        m.team2,
        m.season,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    GROUP BY m.match_id
)
SELECT 
    team1 AS Team1,
    team2 AS Team2,
    season AS Season,
    total_runs AS "Total Runs"
FROM MatchTotals
WHERE total_runs = (SELECT MAX(total_runs) FROM MatchTotals);

question: ਕਿੰਨੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਨੇ ਹਾਰਨ ਵਾਲੀ ਟੀਮ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਠੀਕ 110 ਰਨ ਬਣਾਏ, ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕਿੰਨਿਆਂ ਨੇ 2 ਪਾਰੀਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਕੀਤੀ?
gold_sql: WITH LosingSideInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), PlayerTotals AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(*) AS innings_count FROM LosingSideInnings GROUP BY player_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS players_with_110_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN innings_count = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS players_with_110_in_2_innings FROM PlayerTotals WHERE total_runs = 110;
gold_column_names: Number of players with 110 runs in 2 innings
generated_sql:
WITH runs_per_inning AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.striker_id,
        m.match_winner,
        d.batting_team,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id
),
players_110_losing AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT striker_id
    FROM runs_per_inning
    WHERE total_runs = 110 
      AND batting_team != match_winner
      AND match_winner IS NOT NULL
),
innings_count AS (
    SELECT striker_id, COUNT(*) AS innings_played
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT match_id, inning, striker_id
        FROM Deliveries
    ) AS sub
    GROUP BY striker_id
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players_110_losing) AS [Number of players with 110 runs],
    (SELECT COUNT(*) 
     FROM players_110_losing p 
     JOIN innings_count i ON p.striker_id = i.striker_id 
     WHERE i.innings_played = 2) AS [Number of players with 110 runs in 2 innings];
generated_column_names: Number of players with 110 runs in 2 innings

question: ఓడిపోయిన జట్టులో సరిగ్గా 110 పరుగులు చేసిన ఆటగాళ్ల సంఖ్య ఎంత, మరియు వారిలో 2 ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లలో బ్యాటింగ్ చేసిన వారు ఎంతమంది ?
gold_sql: WITH LosingSideInnings AS (SELECT d.striker_id AS player_id, d.match_id, d.inning, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS innings_runs FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND d.batting_team != m.match_winner GROUP BY d.striker_id, d.match_id, d.inning), PlayerTotals AS (SELECT player_id, SUM(innings_runs) AS total_runs, COUNT(*) AS innings_count FROM LosingSideInnings GROUP BY player_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS players_with_110_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN innings_count = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS players_with_110_in_2_innings FROM PlayerTotals WHERE total_runs = 110;
gold_column_names: Number of players with 110 runs in 2 innings
generated_sql:
WITH LosingTeamPlayers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    m.match_id,
    m.match_winner,
    pim.player_id,
    pim.team_name
  FROM Matches m
  JOIN PlayerInMatch pim 
    ON m.match_id = pim.match_id 
    AND pim.team_name <> m.match_winner
  WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
    AND m.match_winner <> ''
),

PlayerRunsInLosingMatches AS (
  SELECT 
    lt.player_id,
    d.match_id,
    d.inning,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_in_inning
  FROM LosingTeamPlayers lt
  JOIN Deliveries d 
    ON lt.match_id = d.match_id 
    AND lt.player_id = d.striker_id
  GROUP BY lt.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning
),

TotalRunsPerPlayer AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    SUM(runs_in_inning) AS total_runs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT (match_id || '-' || inning)) AS innings_count
  FROM PlayerRunsInLosingMatches
  GROUP BY player_id
),

PlayersWithExactly110 AS (
  SELECT player_id
  FROM TotalRunsPerPlayer
  WHERE total_runs = 110
),

question: T20 ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ Australia ਦੇ ਖਿਲਾਫ਼ ਕਿਸ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ ਦੀ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਔਸਤ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਹੈ?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Australia' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(player_out_id) FROM Deliveries d2 WHERE d2.player_out_id = p.player_id AND d2.bowling_team = 'Australia'), 0)) DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH AgainstAustraliaRuns AS (
    SELECT 
        d.striker_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE (m.team1 = 'Australia' OR m.team2 = 'Australia')
      AND d.batting_team != 'Australia'
    GROUP BY d.striker_id
),
AgainstAustraliaOuts AS (
    SELECT 
        d.player_out_id,
        COUNT(*) AS outs
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
    WHERE (m.team1 = 'Australia' OR m.team2 = 'Australia')
      AND d.batting_team != 'Australia'
      AND d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL
      AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY d.player_out_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name
FROM AgainstAustraliaRuns r
LEFT JOIN AgainstAustraliaOuts o ON r.striker_id = o.player_out_id
JOIN Players p ON r.striker_id = p.player_id
WHERE o.outs > 0
ORDER BY (r.total_runs * 1.0 / o.outs) DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: For Hetmyer, Farhan, and Kishan — what percentage of their total runs came from boundaries in T-20 season 2026?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name, (SUM(CASE WHEN d.runs_scored IN (4, 6) THEN d.runs_scored ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(d.runs_scored), 0)) AS boundary_percentage FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id WHERE p.player_name LIKE '%Hetmyer%' OR p.player_name LIKE '%Farhan%' OR p.player_name LIKE '%Kishan%' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name;
generated_sql:
WITH matched_players AS (
    SELECT player_id, player_name
    FROM Players
    WHERE player_name LIKE '%Hetmyer%' OR player_name LIKE '%Farhan%' OR player_name LIKE '%Kishan%'
),
runs_agg AS (
    SELECT striker_id,
           SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs,
           SUM(CASE WHEN runs_scored IN (4,6) THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    INNER JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season = '2026'
    GROUP BY striker_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS "Player Name",
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(r.total_runs, 0) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE ROUND((COALESCE(r.boundary_runs, 0) * 100.0 / r.total_runs), 2)
    END AS "Boundary Percentage"
FROM matched_players p
LEFT JOIN runs_agg r ON p.player_id = r.striker_id
ORDER BY p.player_name;

question: Which Batsmen has the highest batting average against Australia in T20 history?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Australia' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(player_out_id) FROM Deliveries d2 WHERE d2.player_out_id = p.player_id AND d2.bowling_team = 'Australia'), 0)) DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH RunsAgainstAus AS (
    SELECT 
        striker_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE d.batting_team != 'Australia' 
      AND d.bowling_team = 'Australia'
    GROUP BY striker_id
),
DismissalsAgainstAus AS (
    SELECT 
        player_out_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_outs
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE d.batting_team != 'Australia' 
      AND d.bowling_team = 'Australia'
      AND wicket_type IS NOT NULL
      AND wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY player_out_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name
FROM Players p
JOIN RunsAgainstAus r ON p.player_id = r.striker_id
LEFT JOIN DismissalsAgainstAus d ON p.player_id = d.player_out_id
WHERE (d.total_outs > 0 OR r.total_runs > 0)
ORDER BY (r.total_runs * 1.0) / (COALESCE(d.total_outs, 0) + (CASE WHEN d.total_outs IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: T20 ఇతిహాసలో Australia కి వ్యతిరేకంగా ఏ బ్యాట్స్మ్యాన్ దగ్గర అన్నిటికన్నా పెద్ద బ్యాటింగ్ ఆవెరేజ్ ఉన్నది?
gold_sql: SELECT p.player_name FROM Players p JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id WHERE d.bowling_team = 'Australia' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name ORDER BY (SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(player_out_id) FROM Deliveries d2 WHERE d2.player_out_id = p.player_id AND d2.bowling_team = 'Australia'), 0)) DESC LIMIT 1;

WITH inning_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        striker_id,
        match_id,
        inning,
        SUM(runs_scored) as runs_in_inning,
        MAX(CASE WHEN player_out_id = striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as is_dismissed
    FROM Deliveries

question: Name the two players who have exactly 4 ducks (0s), played for the same country.
gold_sql: WITH PlayerScores AS (SELECT d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.batting_team, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs, MAX(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id = d.striker_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_out FROM Deliveries d GROUP BY d.match_id, d.striker_id, d.batting_team), DuckCounts AS (SELECT striker_id, batting_team, COUNT(match_id) AS ducks FROM PlayerScores WHERE runs = 0 AND is_out = 1 GROUP BY striker_id, batting_team HAVING ducks = 4) SELECT p1.player_name, p2.player_name FROM DuckCounts d1 JOIN DuckCounts d2 ON d1.batting_team = d2.batting_team AND d1.striker_id < d2.striker_id JOIN Players p1 ON d1.striker_id = p1.player_id JOIN Players p2 ON d2.striker_id = p2.player_id LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerDucks AS (
    SELECT 
        striker_id AS player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT match_id || '_' || inning) AS duck_count
    FROM Deliveries d1
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM Deliveries d2 
        WHERE d2.match_id = d1.match_id 
            AND d2.inning = d1.inning 
            AND d2.striker_id = d1.striker_id 
            AND d2.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
            AND d2.player_out_id = d1.striker_id
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM Deliveries d3 
        WHERE d3.match_id = d1.match_id 
            AND d3.inning = d1.inning 
            AND d3.striker_id = d1.striker_id 
            AND d3.runs_scored > 0
    )
    GROUP BY striker_id
    HAVING duck_count = 4
),
PlayerTeams AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        pd.player_id,
        pim.team_name
    FROM PlayerDucks pd
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON pd.player_id = pim.player_id
),
TeamPairs AS (
    SELECT 
        pt1.player_id AS player1_id,
        pt2.player_id AS player2_id,
        pt1.team_name
    FROM PlayerTeams pt1
    JOIN PlayerTeams pt2 
        ON pt1.team_name = pt2.team_name 
        AND pt1.player_id < pt2.player_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT 
    p.player_name AS "Player Name"
FROM (
    SELECT player1_id AS player_id FROM TeamPairs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT player2_id AS player_id FROM TeamPairs
) combined
JOIN Players p ON combined.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY "Player Name";

question: उन दो खिलाड़ियों के नाम बताइए जिनके ठीक 4 डक (0) हैं और जो एक ही देश के लिए खेले।

question: T20I ఇతిహాసలో ఏ టీం 15.7 రన్ రేట్ తో 314 పరుగులు సంపాదించి? వేయతిరేకమైన టీం, కోల్పోయిన వికెట్లు మరియు తేదీ రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT d.batting_team, d.bowling_team AS opposition, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired out') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets_lost, m.match_date FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team, d.bowling_team, m.match_date HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 314;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    d.batting_team AS `Batting Team`,
    CASE 
        WHEN d.batting_team = m.team1 THEN m.team2 
        ELSE m.team1 
    END AS `Opposition`,
    10 - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
        AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') 
        THEN d.bowler_id 
    END) AS `Wickets`,
    m.match_date AS `Date`
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE d.inning = 1
GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team
HAVING 
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) = 314 
    AND (SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) * 1.0) / (COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) / 6.0) = 15.7;

question: T20I ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ 15.70 ਦੀ ਰਨ ਰੇਟ ਨਾਲ 314 ਰਨ ਬਣਾਏ — ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ, ਗੁਆਈਆਂ ਵਿਕਟਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਦੱਸੋ?

question: टी20I इतिहास में 314 रन बनाकर 15.70 का रन रेट किस टीम ने हासिल किया? उसकी विपक्षी टीम, खोए गए विकेट और तारीख बताइए।

question: सबसे कम वाइड्स देते हुए सबसे अधिक नो-बॉल किस टीम ने फेंकी? विपक्षी टीम और नो-बॉल से वाइड्स का अनुपात भी बताइए।
gold_sql: SELECT bowling_team, batting_team AS opposing_team, (SUM(noballs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(wides), 0)) AS nb_to_wide_ratio FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, bowling_team, batting_team ORDER BY SUM(noballs) DESC, SUM(wides) ASC LIMIT 1;

    d1.bowling_team AS `Bowling Team`,
    d1.batting_team AS `Opposing Team`,
    ROUND(1.0 * d1.total_nb / NULLIF(d1.total_wides, 0), 2) AS `Nb/Wides Ratio`
FROM (
    SELECT 
        bowling_team,
        batting_team,
        SUM(noballs) AS total_nb,
        SUM(wides) AS total_wides
    FROM Deliveries
    GROUP BY bowling_team, batting_team
    HAVING total_wides > 0

            SUM(wides) AS total_wides
        FROM Deliveries
        GROUP BY bowling_team, batting_team

            FROM Deliveries

question: ఏ టీం అన్నిటికన్నా తక్కువ వైడ్లు ఇస్తూ అన్నిటికన్నా ఎక్కువ నో బాల్స సంపాదించింది? వ్యతిరేకమైన టీం మరియు నో బాల్స/వైడ్ల రేషియో రాయండి.
gold_sql: SELECT bowling_team, batting_team AS opposing_team, (SUM(noballs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(wides), 0)) AS nb_to_wide_ratio FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, bowling_team, batting_team ORDER BY SUM(noballs) DESC, SUM(wides) ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH TeamStats AS (
    SELECT 
        d1.bowling_team,
        d2.bowling_team AS opposing_team,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d1.noballs > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_noballs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d1.wides > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_wides
    FROM Deliveries d1
    INNER JOIN Deliveries d2 ON d1.match_id = d2.match_id 
        AND d1.inning = d2.inning 
        AND d1.bowling_team = d2.batting_team 
        AND d1.batting_team = d2.bowling_team
    GROUP BY d1.bowling_team, d2.bowling_team
),
RankedTeams AS (
    SELECT 
        bowling_team,
        opposing_team,
        total_noballs,
        total_wides,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_wides ASC) AS wides_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_noballs DESC) AS noballs_rank
    FROM TeamStats
)
SELECT 
    bowling_team AS "Bowling Team",
    opposing_team AS "Opposing Team",
    CASE 
        WHEN total_wides = 0 THEN NULL 
        ELSE CAST(total_noballs AS REAL) / total_wides 
    END AS "Nb/Wides Ratio"
FROM RankedTeams
WHERE wides_rank = 1 AND noballs_rank = 1
LIMIT 1;

question: सबसे कम मैचों में 50 टी20I विकेट किस गेंदबाज़ ने पूरे किए? उसका देश, यह उपलब्धि हासिल करने में लगे मैच, उपलब्धि की तारीख, और ठीक-ठीक कितने दिन लगे, बताइए।
gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.team_name AS country, m.match_id, m.match_date, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name, m.match_id, m.match_date), RunningStats AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS match_number, SUM(wickets) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS cumulative_wickets, MIN(match_date) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id) AS debut_date FROM BowlerMatchStats), Milestone AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_number, match_date, debut_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_number ASC) as rn FROM RunningStats WHERE cumulative_wickets >= 50) SELECT p.player_name, m.country, m.match_number, m.match_date, CAST(julianday(m.match_date) - julianday(m.debut_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_taken FROM Milestone m JOIN Players p ON m.player_id = p.player_id WHERE m.rn = 1 ORDER BY m.match_number ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH Player50Wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        d.bowler_id,
        pim.team_name AS Country,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) AS MatchesCount,
        MIN(m.match_date) AS FirstMatchDate,
        MAX(m.match_date) AS AchievementDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) ASC, MIN(m.match_date), MAX(m.match_date)) AS rn
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON d.bowler_id = pim.player_id AND m.match_id = pim.match_id
    WHERE d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')

    GROUP BY d.bowler_id, pim.team_name

)
SELECT 
    pl.player_name AS [Player Name],
    p50.Country AS Country,
    p50.MatchesCount AS [Number of Matches],
    p50.AchievementDate AS Date,
    JULIANDAY(p50.AchievementDate) - JULIANDAY(p50.FirstMatchDate) AS [Days Taken]
FROM Player50Wickets p50
JOIN Players pl ON p50.bowler_id = pl.player_id
WHERE p50.rn = 1;

question: Which bowler reached 50 T20I wickets in the fewest matches. Report the name of his country, number of matches that took him to achieve it, the date he achieved it, and calculate exactly how many days it took him?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.team_name AS country, m.match_id, m.match_date, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name, m.match_id, m.match_date), RunningStats AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS match_number, SUM(wickets) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS cumulative_wickets, MIN(match_date) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id) AS debut_date FROM BowlerMatchStats), Milestone AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_number, match_date, debut_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_number ASC) as rn FROM RunningStats WHERE cumulative_wickets >= 50) SELECT p.player_name, m.country, m.match_number, m.match_date, CAST(julianday(m.match_date) - julianday(m.debut_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_taken FROM Milestone m JOIN Players p ON m.player_id = p.player_id WHERE m.rn = 1 ORDER BY m.match_number ASC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH bowling_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        d.bowler_id,
        d.match_id,
        m.match_date,
        COUNT(*) AS wickets_in_match
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
        AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY d.bowler_id, d.match_id
),
cumulative_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        bw.bowler_id,
        bw.match_id,
        bw.match_date,
        SUM(bw.wickets_in_match) OVER (PARTITION BY bw.bowler_id ORDER BY bw.match_date, bw.match_id) AS total_wickets,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bw.bowler_id ORDER BY bw.match_date, bw.match_id) AS match_number
    FROM bowling_wickets bw

        bowler_id,
        match_id,

    FROM cumulative_wickets

),

    SELECT 
        bw.bowler_id,
        MIN(m.match_date) AS first_match_date

JOIN Players p ON f.bowler_id = p.player_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON f.match_id = pim.match_id AND f.bowler_id = pim.player_id
JOIN bowler_first_match bfm ON f.bowler_id = bfm.bowler_id

gold_sql: WITH BowlerMatchStats AS (SELECT pim.player_id, pim.team_name AS country, m.match_id, m.match_date, SUM(CASE WHEN d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM PlayerInMatch pim JOIN Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id LEFT JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.player_id = d.bowler_id GROUP BY pim.player_id, pim.team_name, m.match_id, m.match_date), RunningStats AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS match_number, SUM(wickets) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_date, match_id) AS cumulative_wickets, MIN(match_date) OVER(PARTITION BY player_id) AS debut_date FROM BowlerMatchStats), Milestone AS (SELECT player_id, country, match_number, match_date, debut_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_number ASC) as rn FROM RunningStats WHERE cumulative_wickets >= 50) SELECT p.player_name, m.country, m.match_number, m.match_date, CAST(julianday(m.match_date) - julianday(m.debut_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_taken FROM Milestone m JOIN Players p ON m.player_id = p.player_id WHERE m.rn = 1 ORDER BY m.match_number ASC LIMIT 1;

        match_id,
        match_date,
        match_number,
        MIN(match_date) OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id) AS first_match_date
    FROM CumulativeWickets
    WHERE total_wickets >= 50
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler_id ORDER BY match_number) = 1
),

    SELECT 
        pim.player_id,
        pim.team_name AS country
    FROM PlayerInMatch pim
    JOIN FiftyWicketMilestone fwm ON pim.match_id = fwm.match_id AND pim.player_id = fwm.bowler_id
)

    p.player_name AS "Player Name",
    pc.country AS "Country",
    fwm.match_number AS "Number of Matches",
    fwm.match_date AS "Date",

FROM FiftyWicketMilestone fwm
JOIN Players p ON fwm.bowler_id = p.player_id
JOIN PlayerCountry pc ON fwm.bowler_id = pc.player_id
ORDER BY fwm.match_number
LIMIT 1;

question: Which bowler took consecutive four wicket hauls where both spells came in the first innings against the same opposition on consecutive days .Report his country, ratio of wickets to runs conceded, and opponents?
gold_sql: WITH BowlerStats AS (SELECT d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team, SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets, SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries d JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id WHERE d.inning = 1 GROUP BY d.match_id, m.match_date, d.bowler_id, d.bowling_team, d.batting_team HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4) SELECT p.player_name, b1.bowling_team AS country, ((b1.wickets + b2.wickets) * 1.0 / NULLIF((b1.runs_conceded + b2.runs_conceded), 0)) AS wicket_to_runs_ratio, b1.batting_team AS opponents FROM BowlerStats b1 JOIN BowlerStats b2 ON b1.bowler_id = b2.bowler_id AND b1.batting_team = b2.batting_team AND date(b2.match_date) = date(b1.match_date, '+1 day') JOIN Players p ON b1.bowler_id = p.player_id;
generated_sql:

    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.bowler_id,
        m.match_date,
        m.team1,
        m.team2,
        d.batting_team AS opponent,
        d.bowling_team AS bowler_team,
        COUNT(CASE 
                WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
                AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') 
                THEN 1 
            END) AS wickets,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) + 
            SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides > 0 OR d.noballs > 0 THEN d.extra_runs ELSE 0 END) AS runs_conceded
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE d.inning = 1
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.bowler_id
    HAVING wickets >= 4
),
consecutive_spells AS (
    SELECT 
        b1.bowler_id,
        b1.opponent,
        b1.bowler_team,
        b1.match_date AS first_date,
        b2.match_date AS second_date,
        b1.wickets + b2.wickets AS total_wickets,
        b1.runs_conceded + b2.runs_conceded AS total_runs
    FROM bowler_innings b1
    JOIN bowler_innings b2 
        ON b1.bowler_id = b2.bowler_id 
        AND b1.opponent = b2.opponent
        AND DATE(b1.match_date) = DATE(b2.match_date, '-1 day')
)

    cs.bowler_team AS "Country",
    ROUND(1.0 * cs.total_wickets / cs.total_runs, 2) AS "Wickets/Runs Conceded",
    cs.opponent AS "Opponents"
FROM consecutive_spells cs
JOIN Players p ON cs.bowler_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY p.player_name;

        AND d1.bowler_id = d2.bowler_id 
        AND d1.over_number = d2.over_number 
        AND d1.ball_number + 1 = d2.ball_number
    JOIN Deliveries d3 ON d1.match_id = d3.match_id 
        AND d1.inning = d3.inning 
        AND d1.bowler_id = d3.bowler_id 
        AND d1.over_number = d3.over_number 
        AND d1.ball_number + 2 = d3.ball_number
    JOIN Deliveries d4 ON d1.match_id = d4.match_id 
        AND d1.inning = d4.inning 
        AND d1.bowler_id = d4.bowler_id 
        AND d1.over_number = d4.over_number 
        AND d1.ball_number + 3 = d4.ball_number
    JOIN Matches m ON d1.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE d1.inning = 1 
        AND d1.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
        AND d1.player_out_id IS NOT NULL
        AND d2.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
        AND d2.player_out_id IS NOT NULL
        AND d3.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
        AND d3.player_out_id IS NOT NULL
        AND d4.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
        AND d4.player_out_id IS NOT NULL
        AND d1.wides = 0 AND d1.noballs = 0
        AND d2.wides = 0 AND d2.noballs = 0
        AND d3.wides = 0 AND d3.noballs = 0
        AND d4.wides = 0 AND d4.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY d1.match_id, d1.bowler_id, m.match_date, m.team2
),
bowler_consecutive_spells AS (
    -- Find bowlers with 2 such spells on consecutive days against same opponent
    SELECT 
        c1.bowler_id,
        c1.opponents
    FROM consecutive_four_wickets c1
    JOIN consecutive_four_wickets c2 ON c1.bowler_id = c2.bowler_id
        AND c1.opponents = c2.opponents
        AND c1.match_id != c2.match_id
        AND DATE(c1.match_date, '+1 day') = DATE(c2.match_date)
    GROUP BY c1.bowler_id, c1.opponents
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c1.match_id) >= 2
),
bowler_stats AS (
    -- Calculate wickets and runs for those matches
    SELECT 
        bcs.bowler_id,
        bcs.opponents,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS match_count,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
            AND d.player_out_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END) AS total_wickets,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs_conceded
    FROM bowler_consecutive_spells bcs
    JOIN Deliveries d ON bcs.bowler_id = d.bowler_id
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id 
        AND bcs.opponents = m.team2
        AND d.inning = 1
    GROUP BY bcs.bowler_id, bcs.opponents
    HAVING match_count >= 2
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS "Player Name",
    '' AS "Country",
    ROUND(CAST(bs.total_wickets AS REAL) / NULLIF(bs.total_runs_conceded, 0), 2) AS "Wickets/Runs Conceded",
    bs.opponents AS "Opponents"
FROM bowler_stats bs
JOIN Players p ON bs.bowler_id = p.player_id
WHERE bs.total_runs_conceded > 0
ORDER BY "Wickets/Runs Conceded" DESC;

        d.match_id,
        d.batting_team AS team,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
        m.match_winner,
        m.season,
        m.match_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN d.batting_team = m.team1 THEN m.team2 
            ELSE m.team1 
        END AS opposition
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season = 'T20I'
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team

    WHERE m.season = 'T20I'

    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.bowling_team

    ti.team AS "Team Name",
    ti.total_runs AS "Score",
    ti.opposition AS "Opposition",
    ti.match_date AS "Match Date"

JOIN bowler_counts bc ON ti.match_id = bc.match_id 
    AND ti.opposition = bc.team

    AND ti.team != ti.match_winner

question: T20I ਵਿੱਚ, ਕਿੰਨੀ ਵਾਰ ਕਿਸੇ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ 220 ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨ ਬਣਾਏ ਜਦੋਂ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਪੰਜ ਗੇਂਦਬਾਜ਼ਾਂ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਫਿਰ ਵੀ ਮੈਚ ਹਾਰ ਗਈ? ਟੀਮਾਂ, ਸਕੋਰ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਰੋਧੀ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਦੱਸੋ?
gold_sql: WITH InningStats AS (SELECT match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team, SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_score, COUNT(DISTINCT bowler_id) AS bowlers_used FROM Deliveries GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, bowling_team) SELECT COUNT(*) OVER() AS grand_total_instances, i.batting_team AS team, i.total_score AS score, i.bowling_team AS opposition, m.match_date FROM InningStats i JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id WHERE i.total_score >= 220 AND i.bowlers_used = 5 AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND i.batting_team != m.match_winner ORDER BY i.total_score DESC;
generated_sql:
WITH innings_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.batting_team AS team,
        m.match_date,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs,
        m.match_winner
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team
),
bowler_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.bowling_team,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) AS bowlers_used
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowling_team
),
qualifying_innings AS (
    SELECT 
        i.match_id,
        i.team,
        i.total_runs AS Score,
        i.match_date,
        i.match_winner,
        opp.team AS opposition
    FROM innings_totals i
    JOIN Matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN bowler_counts bc ON bc.match_id = i.match_id 
        AND bc.inning = i.inning 
        AND bc.bowling_team != i.team
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT match_id, team1 AS team FROM Matches
        UNION ALL
        SELECT match_id, team2 AS team FROM Matches
    ) opp ON opp.match_id = i.match_id AND opp.team != i.team
    WHERE i.total_runs >= 220 
        AND bc.bowlers_used = 5 
        AND i.team != i.match_winner
        AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS "Total Instances",
    team AS "Team Name",
    Score,
    opposition AS "Opposition",
    match_date AS "Match Date"
FROM qualifying_innings
GROUP BY match_id, team
ORDER BY "Total Instances" DESC, "Team Name", Score DESC;

    WHERE stage LIKE '%final%' OR stage LIKE '%semi%' OR stage LIKE '%quarter%'
),
FielderInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        pim.player_id,
        d.match_id,
        d.inning
    FROM PlayerInMatch pim
    JOIN Deliveries d ON pim.match_id = d.match_id AND pim.team_name = d.bowling_team
    WHERE pim.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM KnockoutMatches)
    GROUP BY pim.player_id, d.match_id, d.inning
),
FielderDismissalsCount AS (
    SELECT 
        fd.fielder_id,
        COUNT(*) AS dismissals
    FROM FielderDismissals fd
    JOIN Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
    WHERE d.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM KnockoutMatches)
    GROUP BY fd.fielder_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    fdc.dismissals AS "Dismissals",
    CAST(fdc.dismissals AS REAL) / COUNT(fi.inning) AS "Dismissals per innings"
FROM Players p
JOIN FielderDismissalsCount fdc ON p.player_id = fdc.fielder_id
LEFT JOIN FielderInnings fi ON p.player_id = fi.player_id
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name, fdc.dismissals
ORDER BY fdc.dismissals DESC
LIMIT 1;

gold_answer: [['Ahmed Shehzad', 111, '*', 'Mirpur', '2014', 'Bangladesh'], ['Sahibzada Farhan', 100, '*', 'Colombo SSC', '2026', 'Namibia'], ['Sahibzada Farhan', 100, '', 'Pallekele', '2026', 'Sri Lanka'], ['Umar Akmal', 94, '', 'Mirpur', '2014', 'Australia']]

SELECT 
    Players.player_name AS "Player Name",
    SUM(Deliveries.runs_scored) AS Runs,
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN Deliveries.player_out_id = Players.player_id AND Deliveries.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' THEN 1 END) = 0 
        THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS "Not Out",
    Matches.venue AS Venue,
    Matches.season AS Season,
    CASE 
        WHEN Matches.team1 = 'Pakistan' THEN Matches.team2
        ELSE Matches.team1
    END AS Opponent

JOIN Deliveries ON Matches.match_id = Deliveries.match_id
JOIN Players ON Deliveries.striker_id = Players.player_id

GROUP BY Matches.match_id, Players.player_id, Players.player_name, Matches.venue, Matches.season, 
         CASE WHEN Matches.team1 = 'Pakistan' THEN Matches.team2 ELSE Matches.team1 END
HAVING SUM(Deliveries.runs_scored) > 0

question: T20 World Cups में Zimbabwe की किसी भी विकेट के लिए सबसे बड़ी साझेदारी कौन सी है?
generated_sql:
WITH ZimbabweInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.over_number,
        d.ball_number,
        d.runs_scored,
        d.extra_runs,
        d.batting_team,
        d.wicket_type,
        d.player_out_id
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
        AND d.batting_team = 'Zimbabwe'
        AND d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0
),
PartnershipRuns AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        inning,
        SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) OVER (
            PARTITION BY match_id, inning 
            ORDER BY over_number, ball_number 
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cumulative_runs
    FROM ZimbabweInnings
),
PartnershipScores AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        inning,
        cumulative_runs - COALESCE(
            LAG(cumulative_runs) OVER (
                PARTITION BY match_id, inning 
                ORDER BY cumulative_runs
            ), 0
        ) AS partnership_runs
    FROM PartnershipRuns
    WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ZimbabweInnings zi 
           WHERE zi.match_id = ZimbabweInnings.match_id 
           AND zi.inning = ZimbabweInnings.inning 
           AND zi.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
           AND zi.player_out_id IS NOT NULL) > 0
    GROUP BY match_id, inning, cumulative_runs
)
SELECT 
    MAX(ps.partnership_runs) AS Runs,
    m.team1 AS Team1,
    m.team2 AS Team2,
    m.venue AS Venue,
    m.season AS Season
FROM PartnershipScores ps
JOIN Matches m ON ps.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE ps.partnership_runs > 0
GROUP BY ps.match_id, ps.inning
ORDER BY Runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: What are the highest individual scores in T20 World Cups by players batting at number 7 or below?
gold_answer: [['Dasun Shanaka', 76, '*', 7, 'Pallekele', '2026', 'Sri Lanka'], ['Michael Hussey', 60, '*', 7, 'Gros Islet', '2010', 'Australia'], ['David Wiese', 55, '', 7, 'Geelong', '2022', 'Namibia'], ['Will Jacks', 53, '*', 7, 'Kolkata', '2026', 'England']]
generated_sql:
WITH T20Matches AS (
    SELECT match_id, season, venue
    FROM Matches
    WHERE season LIKE '%T20 World Cup%'
),
DeliveriesInT20 AS (
    SELECT d.*, m.season, m.venue
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN T20Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
),
BattingOrder AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        inning,
        striker_id,
        MIN(batting_team) AS batting_team,
        MIN(over_number * 100 + ball_number) AS first_ball,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY MIN(over_number * 100 + ball_number)) AS batting_position
    FROM DeliveriesInT20
    GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id
),
RunsPerInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        inning,
        striker_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS runs
    FROM DeliveriesInT20
    GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id
),
Dismissals AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        inning,
        player_out_id,
        1 AS is_out
    FROM DeliveriesInT20
    WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY match_id, inning, player_out_id
),
PlayerInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        bo.match_id,
        bo.inning,
        bo.striker_id AS player_id,
        bo.batting_position,
        bo.batting_team,
        rpi.runs,
        CASE WHEN d.is_out IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS not_out
    FROM BattingOrder bo
    JOIN RunsPerInnings rpi ON bo.match_id = rpi.match_id AND bo.inning = rpi.inning AND bo.striker_id = rpi.striker_id
    LEFT JOIN Dismissals d ON bo.match_id = d.match_id AND bo.inning = d.inning AND bo.striker_id = d.player_out_id
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS "Player Name",
    pi.runs AS "Runs",
    pi.not_out AS "Not Out",
    pi.batting_position AS "Bat Pos",
    m.venue AS "Venue",
    m.season AS "Season",
    pi.batting_team AS "Batting Team"
FROM PlayerInnings pi
JOIN Players p ON pi.player_id = p.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON pi.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE pi.batting_position >= 7
ORDER BY pi.runs DESC;

question: T20 World Cups में 7 या उससे नीचे बल्लेबाजी करने वाले खिलाड़ियों के सबसे बड़े व्यक्तिगत स्कोर कौन से हैं?
gold_answer: [['Dasun Shanaka', 76, '*', 7, 'Pallekele', '2026', 'Sri Lanka'], ['Michael Hussey', 60, '*', 7, 'Gros Islet', '2010', 'Australia'], ['David Wiese', 55, '', 7, 'Geelong', '2022', 'Namibia'], ['Will Jacks', 53, '*', 7, 'Kolkata', '2026', 'England']]
generated_sql:
WITH t20_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id, season, venue
    FROM Matches
    WHERE season IN ('2007', '2009', '2010', '2012', '2014', '2016', '2021', '2022', '2024')
),
legal_deliveries AS (
    SELECT delivery_id, match_id, inning, batting_team, striker_id, runs_scored, player_out_id, wicket_type
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE wides = 0 AND noballs = 0
),
batting_order AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id, 
        inning, 
        batting_team, 
        striker_id,
        MIN(delivery_id) AS first_ball,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning, batting_team ORDER BY MIN(delivery_id)) AS bat_pos
    FROM legal_deliveries
    GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, striker_id
),
innings_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id, 
        inning, 
        batting_team, 
        striker_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS runs
    FROM legal_deliveries
    GROUP BY match_id, inning, batting_team, striker_id
),
not_out_status AS (
    SELECT 
        bo.match_id, 
        bo.inning, 
        bo.batting_team, 
        bo.striker_id AS player_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 
                FROM Deliveries d 
                WHERE d.match_id = bo.match_id 
                AND d.inning = bo.inning 
                AND d.batting_team = bo.batting_team
                AND d.player_out_id = bo.striker_id
                AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL
                AND d.wicket_type != 'retired hurt'
            ) THEN 0 
            ELSE 1 
        END AS not_out
    FROM batting_order bo
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name AS "Player Name",
    i.runs AS "Runs",
    n.not_out AS "Not Out",
    bo.bat_pos AS "Bat Pos",
    m.venue AS "Venue",
    m.season AS "Season",
    i.batting_team AS "Batting Team"
FROM innings_scores i
INNER JOIN batting_order bo ON i.match_id = bo.match_id 
    AND i.inning = bo.inning 
    AND i.batting_team = bo.batting_team 
    AND i.striker_id = bo.striker_id
INNER JOIN not_out_status n ON i.match_id = n.match_id 
    AND i.inning = n.inning 
    AND i.batting_team = n.batting_team 
    AND i.striker_id = n.player_id
INNER JOIN Players p ON i.striker_id = p.player_id
INNER JOIN t20_matches m ON i.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE bo.bat_pos >= 7
ORDER BY i.runs DESC;
